note: Machine-readable design standards. Agents read this before writing any HTML. Single source of truth for palette, forbidden patterns, component HTML, and template pipeline.

logo.note: Always inline SVG wordmark — no text/CSS logo, no tag

forbidden.rule: Headers must be white with 3px brand border-bottom
Body background must be #fff, never gray
Section numbers are plain colored text, no filled circles
Sections use flat border-bottom separators, not card wrappers
Only the 11 standard palette vars allowed
No arbitrary hex colors — use CSS variables from shared-base.css.html
No external CSS frameworks — all files must be self-contained
No external font imports — system font stack only
Never use a text or CSS logo — always the inline SVG wordmark
No dark-background metric cards — use .stat-row/.stat (white bg, brand border-top)
Intake forms save to Firestore only — no mailto: in form submit
Never hardcode contact emails in templates — read architectEmail from project.json

collapsibleSection.css: details.section-block { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border) } summary.section-head { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; cursor:pointer; padding:14px 40px; list-style:none } .section-eyebrow { font-size:10px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:2px; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--brand) } .section-title { font-size:16px; font-weight:700; color:var(--dark) } .section-chevron { font-size:11px; color:var(--mid); transition:transform 0.2s } details.section-block[open] .section-chevron { transform:rotate(180deg) } .section-body { padding:4px 40px 24px }
rules: Key sections default open: Challenge, Solution, Flows, Investment, Next Steps
Secondary sections default collapsed: Journey, Outcomes, Timeline, Included, OOS, Assumptions
Conditional sections (ROI, About) emitted by fill-template.js when data present

stickyBar.usage: Proposal documents — floats at top with navigation actions
stickyBar.html: DataSkate x Client Name
stickyBar.css: .sticky-bar { position:sticky; top:0; z-index:100; background:#fff; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); padding:8px 40px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px }
stickyBar.printBehavior: Hidden on print via .sticky-bar { display:none !important } in @media print
